summary: Staged credit hold after regional pricing update causing delayed invoice credits
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports that a scheduled regional pricing update on 2026-03-09 caused their trial/introductory credits to be placed into a staged hold state. The credits do not appear on their March 9–11 invoices or billing preview and usage ledger shows credits as 'pending' with a hold reason 'pricing-sync'.

Impact: SageLogix reports an unexpected invoice balance of $42,100 (USD) for the billing window 2026-03-09 to 2026-03-11. This is blocking month-end reconciliation for their finance team and has escalated to their procurement lead. The customer is on an enterprise contract with reserved capacity in us-west.

Environment: Production (us-west primary throughput, eu-west failover). Pricing update rollouts were targeted to us-west starting 2026-03-09 03:00 UTC and eu-west 2026-03-09 07:00 UTC.

Steps to reproduce / observed behavior:
1) Customer runs daily billing preview for org org-sagelogix (org id: org_82f2).
2) System shows usage lines for token/embedding consumption but credits line is absent; ledger shows credits with status 'pending' and reason 'pricing-sync'.
3) Manual re-run of credit application job (internal) results in application for a subset of earlier days but not the full window.

Expected behavior: Credits tied to the promotional contract should be applied to usage retroactively at the time of the pricing update rollout or flagged for automatic backfill. Customer should not see a transient invoice gap that requires manual intervention.

Relevant logs/IDs: billing_tx_batch: bb-20260309-raw-9f3c, credit_job_id: cj-20260310-99a7, pricing-deploy: rel/pricing/2026-03-09-2.
comments: 2026-03-10, 09:12 - Maya Chen (Support): Logged initial ticket after customer escalation. Attached screenshots of billing preview and ledger export. Asked Finance for any manual holds.

2026-03-10, 11:45 - Liam O'Connor (Billing Eng): Confirmed credit_job_id present in queue; job returned partial success with 207 Accepted for some orgs and 423 Conflict for 'pricing-sync' hold. I requested job logs from job-runner node gn-billing-03.

2026-03-10, 14:02 - Priya Nair (SRE): Observed transient DNS timeouts to pricing-catalog service during rollout window 03:00-03:12 UTC in us-west which coincides with missing credit application responses. Collected tcpdump and systemd journal for gn-billing-03.

2026-03-11, 08:30 - Maya Chen (Support): Customer reports they re-ran their internal reconciliation and the invoice preview still shows the $42,100 gap. Escalated to Customer Success for mitigation messaging.

2026-03-12, 16:05 - Liam O'Connor (Billing Eng): Applied manual backfill for org_82f2 for 2026-03-09 through 2026-03-11. Credit lines now visible in ledger; provisional refund issued for the overage. Waiting for finance to confirm final invoice adjustment.
investigation: Initial hypothesis: pricing service unavailable during rollout caused credit-apply job to mark credits as pending with 'pricing-sync' hold flag instead of retrying.

Correlated job-runner logs (cj-20260310-99a7) show HTTP 503 from pricing-catalog between 03:04:21 and 03:11:08 UTC; job logic sets 'hold' when pricing endpoint returns 5xx for critical pricing lookups.
SRE findings: DNS upstream for pricing-catalog pointed to a stale NSEC record for a subset of us-west nodes; intermittent failure rate ~4.8% across the rollout window.
Billing engine: credit application is idempotent but current backfill task requires manual promotion for holds; there is no automated periodic re-run for 'pricing-sync' holds older than 48h.
resolution: Workaround applied: manual backfill run for org_82f2 credits for affected window; provisional credit/refund processed and communicated to customer (customer-facing message drafted by CS).

Temporary mitigation: added a retry policy on the credit-apply job for 'pricing-sync' hold responses (3 immediate retries with exponential backoff) and queued a targeted backfill job for all orgs with 'pricing-sync' holds in the last 7 days.
Permanent fix plan: update credit-apply controller to convert transient pricing 5xx errors into retriable states and add a 7-day automated backfill sweep for holds labeled 'pricing-sync'.
Finance action: issued provisional refund ID rf-20260312-77; final invoice adjustment pending reconciliation and accounting approvals.
follow_up_actions: ENG-PR: Implement code change to treat pricing-catalog 5xx as transient for credit-apply job rather than immediate 'hold' (PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/842). Owner: Liam O'Connor. Target milestone: 2026-03-19.
SRE: Rotate DNS resolver entries for pricing-catalog and add synthetic checks across rollout windows. Owner: Priya Nair. ETA: 2026-03-15.
Billing Ops: Run a one-time backfill sweep for all 'pricing-sync' holds older than 24h and follow up with finance for any provisional refunds. Owner: Nora Patel (Billing Ops). ETA: 2026-03-14.
CS: Send confirmed refund + invoice adjustment message to SageLogix including internal RCA summary and expected timelines. Owner: Maya Chen. ETA: 2026-03-13.
